name: Pradhan Mantri Mudra Yojana (PMMY)
purpose: Provides institutional credit support to eligible micro enterprises.
benefit: Eligible borrowers may access business credit through participating lending institutions.
relevance: Potentially useful for small businesses requiring funds for working capital or expansion.
eligibility: Eligibility depends on applicable scheme guidelines and lending institution requirements.

name: Prime Minister's Employment Generation Programme (PMEGP)
purpose: Supports eligible new micro enterprises through a credit-linked subsidy mechanism.
benefit: Eligible projects may receive support subject to applicable scheme conditions.
relevance: Potentially relevant for eligible entrepreneurs establishing a new micro enterprise.
eligibility: Eligibility depends on current PMEGP guidelines and project requirements.

name: Credit Guarantee Scheme through CGTMSE
purpose: Provides credit guarantee support for eligible credit facilities.
benefit: Can facilitate access to eligible institutional credit subject to scheme rules.
relevance: Potentially relevant when a small business seeks eligible institutional credit.
eligibility: Subject to current CGTMSE guidelines and lender requirements.

name: Udyam Registration
target: Eligible micro, small and medium enterprises
purpose: Provides official MSME registration through the Udyam Registration system.
benefit: Registration can help eligible enterprises access applicable MSME-related services.
relevance: Useful for businesses that qualify as MSMEs.
eligibility: Subject to applicable MSME classification and registration requirements.
